acceptanceCriteria.text: One versioned persisted mapping binds canonical repository identity to unique UID/GID/internal username and allocation lifecycle.
Two active repositories cannot receive the same UID or GID.
Allocation/release/retry survives injected persistence failure without duplicate or half-authoritative assignments.
Rename/path/remote spelling changes retain the same principal when repository identity continuity is proven.
Different/forked repository identity cannot inherit another principal from similar mutable metadata.
Released identity is not reusable until explicit residual-ownership cleanup/proof makes reuse safe.
Schema/version migration is fail-closed on ambiguity/corruption and never guesses ownership.
Bounded status/debug projection excludes secrets and does not turn usernames into semantic IDs.

issue.title: feat(security): allocate durable collision-safe repository Unix principal identities
